limits: Only the exact assigned blinded packet, criteria and review contract were used. All case observations and concern reports are authored synthetic stipulations; causal links, intervention effects, reader/participant benefits and feasible full-run outcomes have not been measured. Upstream concern reports are fixed inputs. These findings assess the supplied openings and their probes, not whole RobotTalks performance, operational improvement or stakeholder agreement. Every supplied pair and arm is covered; S1:T1/T2 are both assessed where supplied, and each other arm contains T1. Resource stop rules do not confirm that an informative probe can finish within the constraints. Unresolved-contradiction counts identify the independent remaining decision tensions explicitly named in each reason, rather than counting every assumption as a logical inconsistency. Distinctness is local to the incomplete supplied case archives and the other arm; measurement detail, batch size, order and longer disagreement alone do not establish novelty. The intervention-contrast distinction for one S1:T1 is an assessment of causal operation and discriminator, not a demonstrated benefit or proof of global novelty. All supplied arm dispositions are valid; execution dispositions are kept outside this semantic review. Administrative anonymity hides labels, while semantic operations can remain recognizable.
